status.summary: No. 3 women's flyweight contender coming off a loss. She lost 28-29 x3 to Alexa Grasso in a bout billed as a title eliminator at Noche UFC (Sep 12, 2026, Glendale) after being knocked down in R1. Before that she stopped Jasmine Jasudavicius with ground punches at 1:14 of R1 (Oct 18, 2025, Vancouver) and lost a 47-48 x3 decision to Valentina Shevchenko for the flyweight title (UFC 315, May 10, 2025, Montreal). Natalia Silva won the vacant title over Wang Cong at UFC 332 (Oct 3, 2026). Nothing is booked and no injury has been reported as of Nov 6, 2026 (UFCalendar; no news item about her since the Grasso fight was found). Pro MMA record 13-3 (Wikipedia, ESPN, UFCalendar); UFC 8-2, both losses decisions. Age 36, from Nice, France.
status.ranking: #3 women's flyweight and #7 women's pound-for-pound (UFC media-panel rankings of Nov 3, 2026, as mirrored by UFCalendar and ufcrankings.org on Nov 5-6; ufc.com itself not fetched). UFC's algorithmic Meta rankings (Oct 31, 2026) have her #4.

signature: high-volume punching at range: 13.6 significant attempts per minute career (division 9.2); 359 attempts and 172 landed over 25 minutes vs Erin Blanchfield (50-45 x3)
clinch body attack against Shevchenko: 29 of 33 clinch strikes and 35 of 37 body strikes at UFC 315, with 7:07 of control from 1 takedown
accurate body shots at range: 19 of 26 to the body vs Grasso (2026)
stuffing takedowns: opponents completed 3 of 24 attempts on her (career); Blanchfield went 0 for 3 and Rose Namajunas 0 for 6
fast finishes on a hurt opponent: punches at distance vs Leonardo and Ricci (2021), ground punches vs Jasudavicius at 1:14 of R1 (2025)
weaknesses: accuracy: 39% of significant attempts land, time-decayed (division 43%); 51 of 196 head strikes vs Grasso and 39 of 197 vs Namajunas
leg kicks get through: 0.81 leg strikes absorbed per minute, time-decayed (division 0.63); Shevchenko landed 17 of 19, Katlyn Cerminara 20 of 23
knocked down in each of her last two decision losses (Shevchenko R4, Grasso R1)
takedown offence rarely lands: 9 of 31 career, 1 of 12 vs Shevchenko
style.summary: A high-output striker who throws far more than the division average, mostly punches to the head plus body shots, and she is very hard to take down. She keeps her pace into the late rounds. Her limits are accuracy and leg-kick defence. Both decision losses came against sharper counter-strikers who dropped her once.

moves.notes: Weights follow the schema example and src/director.js: head moves sum to 1, body to 1, legs to 1; spinning, knee and elbow are separate rates for specials. Target split from fighters.json: time-decayed significant attempts are 83.6% head, 12.1% body, 4.2% legs (landed 67.1/24.2/8.7); career attempts 82.6/12.2/5.2 (landed 65.4/23.3/11.3); women's flyweight league 77.3/14.0/8.7. She throws to the head more than the division, but her body strikes land so often that they make up a quarter of what she lands. No published technique breakdown was found (re-checked Nov 6, 2026), so the split inside each group is a judgment. The jab and straight lead the head group for a volume puncher. Her karate background (black belt and a French national-team place before MMA, per Wikipedia) gives her head kicks a small share. Body kicks lead the body group as a judgment; vs Grasso at least 17 of her 19 body strikes came at distance (she landed only 2 in the clinch and none on the ground). knee 0.12 reflects the clinch body work vs Shevchenko (29 of 33 clinch strikes, 35 of 37 to the body), which ufcstats does not split by technique. Legs are split evenly because calf vs inside cannot be told apart. Medium-low confidence.

appearance.tattoos: none visible on the arms, shoulders, abdomen or legs (ESPN studio cutouts, May 2025 and Sep 2026)
appearance.kit: black UFC Venum set with knee-length compression-style shorts (ESPN cutout, Sep 2026, and the Noche UFC fight photo); the white Venum studio set in May 2025. The corner colour wins in the sim

engine_notes.note: Volume: 12.9 significant attempts per minute time-decayed and 13.6 career (division 9.2), landing 5.05 and 5.56 per minute (division 3.98). She absorbs 4.08 per minute, decayed.
Takedown defence is elite: 87.5% career, 86% decayed (division 61%). Opponents' control is 43 s per 15 min, decayed (division 180).

Late rounds: in her two 5-round fights (Blanchfield, Shevchenko) her output by round is 1.00, 0.95, 1.05, 1.46, 1.46 of round 1, against a division curve of 1.00, 0.90, 1.01, 1.14, 1.32. Only two fights, but she out-landed both opponents in R5 (42-27 vs Blanchfield, 18-15 vs Shevchenko).

Chin: 2 knockdowns absorbed in 10 UFC fights, both in her two losses; 0.65 per 100 head strikes absorbed career (division 0.25). No KO loss. Knockdown power is low: 1 knockdown scored, though she has 3 KO/TKO wins.
Elo 1672, fourth among flyweights who have fought since Nov 2024 (Shevchenko 1750, Silva 1722, Blanchfield 1676).
